definition.name: Virtual multimeter
definition.description: Voltage and resistance probes read the solver rather than recorded values.

parts.name: Housing
parts.purpose: The enclosure supports and separates functional parts. This original teaching model is representative equipment, not a manufacturer drawing.

parts.name: Removable cover
parts.purpose: The cover limits access to internal connections. Opening it here is a virtual inspection operation.

parts.name: Terminal clamps
parts.purpose: Metal clamps establish connections to individual conductors. The circuit engine connects terminal IDs, not the apparent proximity of 3D wires.

parts.name: Mounting and fixings
parts.purpose: Mounting hardware supports the equipment. Screws, rail clips and glands are modelled separately from electrical connections.

parts.name: Display and indicators
parts.purpose: The display reports the model operating state. Meter readings come from the connected circuit, not a pre-recorded picture.

parts.name: Operating mechanism
parts.purpose: The mechanism translates a handle, button, coil or control demand into an operating state.

parts.name: Test probes and sockets
parts.purpose: The red and black probes contact two circuit terminals for a voltage or resistance reading. Voltage is measured between those terminals; resistance and continuity require the simulated supply to be off. The probe sockets and insulated leads are separate from the mode selector.
